meta.description: kunpeng DMN extension attributes on dmn:Decision. Single-value string extensions use the abstract-mixin + isAttr idiom (moddle serializes them as namespaced XML attributes); property names are lowerCamelCase to match the DMN attribute naming convention. The properties panel reads/writes these via bo.get()/modeling.updateProperties() with the prefixed keys kunpeng:versionTag / kunpeng:historyTimeToLive.
